references.text: Describes the law of the half-shekel tax that all Israelites must pay for service in the Tabernacle, which can be related to the question of Jesus' payment of the temple tax in Matthew 17:24.
Refers to reverence for the Lord and rejects human wealth, which can be seen in connection with Jesus' attitude toward the temple tax.
Jesus is asked whether it is right to pay taxes to Caesar, a question that mirrors the issue of the temple tax in Matthew 17:24.
